# Tequila Fest Columbus

> Columbus's biggest annual tequila festival — 50+ premium tequila brands, authentic tacos, live music, and VIP experiences.

## Event Information

- **Event:** Tequila Fest Columbus 2027
- **Date:** Saturday, August 14, 2027
- **Event Hours:** 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM
- **Tequila Sampling Hours:** 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM
- **Venue:** To be announced — Columbus, Ohio
- **Tickets:** https://www.tequilafestusa.com/events/columbus
- **Presenting Sponsor:** Código 1530

## Ticket Status

Tickets for the 2027 festival are not on sale yet. The event is listed as
coming soon on TequilaFestUSA.com; the venue and on-sale date will be
announced there and on this site.

## What to Expect

Tequila Fest Columbus is an annual celebration of tequila culture in central Ohio. Attendees 21+ can:

- Sample 50+ premium tequila brands (blanco, reposado, añejo, extra añejo, and mezcal)
- Enjoy authentic tacos and Mexican-inspired food
- Dance to live music from DJ Fusemania (3–6 PM) and Apostle Jones Band (6:30–9 PM)
- Upgrade to VIP for early access, exclusive tequila pours, and premium amenities

## Admission Options

- General Admission (includes tequila sampling 4–8 PM)
- VIP Experience (early entry, premium tequila brands, dedicated lounge)
- Designated Driver tickets available

## Location

Columbus, Ohio — specific venue to be announced.

Tequila Fest USA — https://tequilafestusa.com
